name: io.github.halfaipg/glados-mcp
title: GLaDOS Voice
description: Local text-to-speech: your AI assistant speaks aloud as GLaDOS or one of 26 Kokoro voices.

environmentVariables.name: GLADOS_MCP_DEFAULT_VOICE
environmentVariables.description: Voice used when a speak call does not name one: "glados" or a Kokoro voice such as "af_alloy".

environmentVariables.name: GLADOS_MCP_MODELS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the downloaded voice models (about 300 MB). Defaults to the per-user cache directory.
